techniques.name: 黑底烟雾滤色叠加与边缘处理
techniques.intent: 使烟雾素材叠在画面文字区域，消除黑底并避免素材边框穿帮。

timing.rule: Discard black-only preroll/tail; compose only on the declared caption interval.

pitfalls: Screen blend is deterministic but smoke shape and motion require an actual asset; title alone cannot synthesize exact smoke.
Screen and lighten differ on bright backgrounds.
A cropped smoke asset can carry a hard horizontal edge; translating the edge outside the canvas is demonstrated.
Compositing smoke over text does not prove glyph pixels physically dissolve into simulated particles.
validation: Black source areas leave the background unchanged under screen.
Inspect smoke boundary at beginning, peak and disappearance for visible straight edges.
Check positioned smoke intersects the intended text region and does not cover unintended subjects.

techniques.name: 烟雾重定时匹配字幕区间
techniques.intent: 让每段烟雾从字幕开头开始并在该字幕结束时完成。

speed.rule: derive from precise source bounds, not rounded UI values

pitfalls: Trimming an animation to2seconds is not equivalent to retiming its complete evolution to2seconds.
UI duration and speed values are rounded and need not divide exactly.
Changing speed alters motion smoothness; frame interpolation policy must be chosen explicitly.
validation: All smoke intervals align with corresponding caption starts/ends within one frame.
Inspect full smoke evolution at the shortest and longest target durations.

techniques.name: 竖排歌词与逐字出场配合烟雾
techniques.intent: 文字逐步消失时由烟雾掩饰，形成整体消散观感。

timing.rule: Normalize progress over each full caption interval; smoke retiming follows the same interval.

pitfalls: Exact 打字机2 disappearance ordering/interpolation is proprietary and not established by static frames.
Automatic lyric recognition requires correction before any displayed captions are called accurate.
Opacity must be checked for readability against the actual background.
validation: Verify text against audition or authoritative lyrics before use.
Inspect first/middle/last visible glyph and smoke alignment per caption.
No glyph remains after its caption interval and no premature disappearance obscures necessary words.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified; lyric spellings, song name, exact preset behavior and optional filter identity are not certified.
Exact smoke source/license, proprietary blend color-space behavior and retiming interpolation are unknown.
